Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
t_count number;
t_lab varchar2 (5);
begin
 :SYSTEM.message_level :=25;
 :GLOBAL.eff_val_flag := 'Y';
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;

 :global.flag1 := 0;
 next_item;
 select count(*) into t_count from valid_testing_labs
 where testing_lab_id = :testing_lab_id and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 :global.t_lab := :testing_lab_id;
 if t_count > 0 then
 :val_test_labs.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 :global.flag1 := 1;
 --:global.t_lab := :testing_lab_id;
 :val_test_labs.address_id := null;
 :addresses.address_id := null;
 set_block_property('VAL_TEST_LABS',default_where,'testing_lab_id =:global.t_lab');
 :GLOBAL.eff_val_flag := 'N';
 execute_query(NO_VALIDATE);
 :val_test_labs1.eff_date := :val_test_labs.eff_date;
 :val_test_labs1.term_date := :val_test_labs.term_date;
 :val_test_labs1.last_modified_date := :val_test_labs.last_modified_date;
 --message(to_char(:val_test_labs.address_id));pause;
 go_block('ADDRESSES');
 execute_query(NO_VALIDATE); 
 go_item('val_test_labs.testing_lab_name');
 else
 :GLOBAL.eff_val_flag := 'Y';
 clear_form(no_validate);
 execute_trigger('SBC_BANNER');
 :val_test_labs.testing_lab_id := :global.t_lab;
 :val_test_labs.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 go_item('val_test_labs.testing_lab_name');
 end if; 

 if :global.flag1 = 0 then
 select address_seq.nextval into :addresses.address_id
 from dual;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF nvl(:int_flag ,'N')='N' THEN

if :addresses.state_code is null then
nullchk;
check_package_failure;
else
begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'STATE'
 and code = :addresses.state_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Invalid State Code ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
-- when others then handle_error;
end;
end if;

else
 return;
end if;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
t_date date;
begin
 :GLOBAL.c_item := :system.cursor_item;
 enter;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 25;
 if :system.form_status in( 'CHANGED' ,'NEW') then
 IF :val_test_labs.testing_lab_id is null THEN
 go_item('val_test_labs.testing_lab_id');
 execute_trigger('validate_item');
 return;
 ELSIF :val_test_labs.testing_lab_name is null THEN
 go_item('val_test_labs.testing_lab_name');
 execute_trigger('when-validate-item');
 return;
 ELSIF :val_test_labs.contract_id is null THEN
 go_item('val_test_labs.contract_id');
 execute_trigger('when-validate-item');
 return;
 ELSIF :addresses.addr_1 is null THEN
 go_item('addresses.addr_1');
 execute_trigger('when-validate-item');
 return;
 ELSIF :addresses.city is null THEN
 go_item('addresses.city');
 execute_trigger('when-validate-item');
 return;
 ELSIF :addresses.state_code is null or :addresses.state_code is not null THEN
 go_item('addresses.state_code');
 execute_trigger('validate_item');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :addresses.zip is null THEN
 go_item('addresses.zip');
 execute_trigger('when-validate-item');
 return;
 ELSIF :addresses.country is null THEN
 go_item('addresses.country');
 execute_trigger('when-validate-item');
 return; 
 END IF;
 IF :GLOBAL.c_item = 'VAL_TEST_LABS1.TERM_DATE' THEN
 go_item('val_test_labs1.term_date');
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_ITEM'); 
 check_package_failure;
 go_item('val_test_labs1.eff_date');
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_ITEM'); 
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 go_item('val_test_labs1.eff_date');
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_ITEM'); 
 check_package_failure;
 go_item('val_test_labs1.term_date');
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_ITEM'); 
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 elsif :system.form_status in( 'QUERY' ) then
 --message('Msg:No changes to commit');
 show_error('8013');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 :system.message_level := 5;
 -- commit_form;
 check_pass; --Added by edwin on 12.12.2001
 if not form_success then
 :system.message_level := 25;
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm'); 
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else 
 bell;
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item('val_test_labs.testing_lab_id');
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 end if;
end;
